finding: The persistent Shatter-flow power passed both local Duskblade edges on discovery and held-out evidence while both Ashwarden controls stayed exactly zero. The discovery pilot panel decisively rejected it: Chisel's Duskblade activation upper 95% bound was -0.1457 SD and Annealing Rite's was 0.0164 SD. Ordinary Duskblade attacks already Shatter, so the power had a strong standalone effect and neither named producer was necessary; increasing its payoff would not repair the missing producer-consumer complementarity.
noFurtherRows: No held-out panel rows were run after the decisive discovery rejection.
No protected acceptance or reserve seed was used.
rootCause: A generic payoff on Shatter can be activated by the baseline Duskblade deck, so factorial AB cannot identify the intended package. A later prototype must require an explicit producer-consumer handshake that neutral cards cannot activate.
